_comment: S2 screening: the 110,202 fractions with 6,733 CLUSTER-SUM columns APPENDED. Unitigs were grouped by approximate sequence similarity (containment >= 0.30 over canonical 15-mers, threshold fixed before looking; 6,733 multi-member clusters covering 19,364 unitigs, median 2 members, max 43, no chaining) and each cluster contributes the sum of its members' fractions. This is the borrowing mechanism: a class with 11 training runs cannot identify which of 110,202 individual features matter, but a cluster column pools look-alikes and so raises the effective support behind it. Singletons get no column, since their sum is their own fraction and would duplicate an existing one. Appended columns standardised on that fold's four TRAINING folds only. 6,733 extra columns are far more parameters than S1's 136, so this can lose more clearly if the mechanism is not real. Score with 26_pooled_representation_test.py: pooled out-of-fold predictions, eligibility once, paired bootstrap over BioProjects, never fold means; report SPLIT BY REGIME, since few-shot is the target. Held-out untouched.
